guidance.summary: Annual capex guidance of INR 12 billion to 16 billion through FY30
guidance.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
guidance.quote: Capital expenditure for the quarter was at ₹ 3.3 billion, taking the H1 FY 2026 expenditure to around ₹ 7.5 billion, in line with our Project Spring guidance of investing ₹ 12 billion - ₹ 16 billion annually through to FY 2030.

guidance.summary: Targeting greater than 10% export contribution goal by FY30
guidance.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
guidance.quote: We remain on track toward our greater than 10% export contribution goal.

guidance.summary: Targeting 8% to 10% FMEG EBITDA margin by FY30
guidance.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
guidance.quote: In FMEG, we continue to outpace industry growth in line with our plan of growing 1.5x to 2x the market rate, while maintaining focus on margin improvement and progressing towards the 8%-10% EBITDA target by FY 2030.

guidance.summary: Targeting to cross 30% dividend payout by FY30
guidance.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
guidance.quote: For FY 2025, we raised our dividend payout to 26.3% from 25.5% last year, in line with our goal of crossing 30% dividend payout by FY 2030.

guidance.summary: Five-year company margin guidance of 11% to 13%
guidance.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
guidance.quote: Achal, the guidance of 11% to 13% of margins is a 5-year guidance.

guidance.summary: Full-year FY26 capex expected between INR 1,200 crores to 1,600 crores
guidance.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
guidance.quote: This year as well, we are at ₹ 750 crores in the first half, and we'll perhaps do somewhere between ₹ 1,200 crores to ₹ 1,600 crores for the year.
